name: Magangué (Colombia)
description: Green field with a white rectangle charged with the municipal arms of Magangué (a beehive and cross on red with crossed rifles and flags).
history: Municipal flag of Magangué, a municipality in the department of Bolívar, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Magangué arms — beehive and cross on red, with crossed rifles and flags
